discovery.summary: Generate multi-section infographic posters via Gemini, vertically stitched into a single tall PNG. Optional Qwen-Edit refinement.

hints.when: user asks for an infographic / poster / 信息图 / 海报 / visual summary
picking a built-in style (cyberpunk-neon / editorial / clean-light / multi-panel) or designing a custom inline style
listing available styles or inspecting style prompts
writing the sections JSON, picking section variants, or needing a worked example (tech / business / editorial / batch)
choosing CLI flags, resolution (1K/2K/4K), aspect, or wiring mofa/config.json
estimating run time, hitting the 600s timeout, or deciding rt vs batch API mode
gathering preferences from the user on Telegram (style / sections / resolution) via inline keyboard
diagnosing why a previous run was rejected for using /tmp or another absolute path

tools.name: mofa_infographic
tools.spawn_only_message: SUCCESS: Infographic generation is now running in background. The infographic image will be automatically delivered when ready. No further action needed for this request.
tools.description: Generate multi-section infographics with AI-generated visuals. Runs in background — do NOT wait for it.

variant.description: Style variant for this section (e.g. 'header', 'normal', 'footer'). Defaults to 'header' for first section, 'footer' for last, 'normal' for middle sections.

refine_prompt.description: Optional Qwen-Edit instruction to refine this section after generation (e.g. 'increase contrast')

out.description: Output PNG file path. Use a relative path (e.g. output.png) — never use /tmp.

api.description: API mode: rt (realtime, fast) or batch (50% cheaper, async)
